en.context: Bausch Health is reviewed on its consolidated pharmaceutical and eye-health reporting basis.
en.summary: For the quarter ended 2026-06-30, revenue rose 12.7% versus the comparable prior-year period. Operating margin increased from 17.5% to 25.9%; operating cash flow for the 2026-01-01 → 2026-06-30 was USD 0.9 billion.
en.uncertainty: Current long-term debt is USD 0.87 billion and the noncurrent component is USD 19.88 billion, alongside USD 1.83 billion cash. These components are not total debt; maturity terms and cash restrictions still require review.
monitoring: Changes in current long-term debt and cash, alongside disclosed maturity terms.
Product revenue concentration and patent-related disclosures.

fa.context: باوش هلث بر اساس گزارش تلفیقی دارو و سلامت چشم بررسی شده است.
fa.summary: در سه‌ماهه منتهی به 2026-06-30، درآمد نسبت به دورهٔ مشابه سال قبل ۱۲٫۷٪ رشد کرد. حاشیهٔ سود عملیاتی از ۱۷٫۵٪ به ۲۵٫۹٪ رسید (افزایش)؛ جریان نقد عملیاتی 2026-01-01 → 2026-06-30 ۰٫۹ میلیارد دلار آمریکا بود.
fa.uncertainty: بخش جاری بدهی بلندمدت ۰٫۸۷ و بخش غیرجاری ۱۹٫۸۸ میلیارد دلار آمریکا است؛ نقد ۱٫۸۳ میلیارد است. این اجزا معادل کل بدهی نیستند و برنامهٔ سررسید و محدودیت نقدینگی هنوز باید بررسی شود.
monitoring: تغییر بخش جاری بدهی و نقد در گزارش بعدی، همراه با سررسیدهای افشاشده.
تمرکز درآمد محصولات و افشاهای مربوط به پتنت‌ها.

comparison.method: Same-filing, same-duration prior-year comparison; operating income / revenue

en.context: SSR Mining is reviewed as a gold and silver producer.
en.summary: For the quarter ended 2026-06-30, revenue rose 9.5% versus the comparable prior-year period. Operating margin increased from 41.5% to 43.2%; operating cash flow for the 2026-01-01 → 2026-06-30 was USD 0.36 billion.
en.uncertainty: Total operating cash is USD 0.36 billion versus USD 0.42 billion from continuing operations. These scopes must not be treated as equivalent. Per-ounce costs and commodity-price effects have not been assessed.
monitoring: Production and the source-defined mining-cost measures.

comparison.method: Same-filing, same-duration prior-year comparison; operating income / revenue

fa.context: SSR Mining به‌عنوان تولیدکنندهٔ طلا و نقره بررسی شده است.

monitoring: تفکیک نتایج عملیات ادامه‌دار و متوقف‌شده.

en.context: The business reviewed is Meta Platforms, the company underlying the CAD-hedged CDR.
en.summary: For the quarter ended 2026-06-30, revenue rose 28% versus the comparable prior-year period. Operating margin decreased from 43% to 30.9%; operating cash flow for the 2026-01-01 → 2026-06-30 was USD 64.09 billion.
en.uncertainty: Cash payments for property and equipment were USD 49.11 billion over the same period. Operating cash less these payments is USD 14.98 billion. This is not issuer-defined free cash flow and excludes other investment outflows and lease commitments.
monitoring: Operating-margin changes in the next comparable quarter.
Changes in property/equipment cash spending relative to operating cash, over matching periods.

comparison.method: Same-filing, same-duration prior-year comparison; operating income / revenue
